# laravelforge_server_php_pool_config (Resource)

Manages the php-fpm pool configuration of a PHP version on a Laravel Forge server (singleton per PHP version).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) The php-fpm pool configuration contents to write.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `php_version_id` (Number) ID of the PHP version whose pool config is managed.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the PHP version belongs to.

### Optional

- `user` (String) Optional pool user to scope the configuration to.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (String) The current php-fpm pool configuration as returned by Forge.
